name: Cold waves & winter storms
summary: No top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region on 19 Nov; heavy snow limited to US western mountains
state: US National Weather Service offices issued winter storm watches for the Sierra Nevada and southern Cascades above 4,000 feet from 17 to 20 Nov, with 1 to 3 feet of snow forecast above 6,000 feet and heavy rain for Los Angeles (Nature World News). The warnings cover mountain areas rather than a major populated region, and searches on 19 Nov found no top-tier cold warning across a major region and no cold-related power or gas outages, so Normal is kept.
for_you: Mountain travel in California and Oregon may need chains or face closures until 20 Nov; check National Weather Service and state road advice. In the UK, the Met Office and UKHSA publish cold-weather warnings and alerts.
rubric_hit: Normal: no top-tier cold or winter-storm warning across a major region; Sierra Nevada winter storm watches are mountain-only

sources.title: Nature World News — Winter storm watches cover Sierra through Friday; Pacific storms bring rain to Los Angeles

why: Severe cold and winter storms kill, cut power and spike gas demand, as in Texas in 2021; they matter most when energy supplies are tight.
drivers: Polar vortex disruption, blocking highs, ENSO, Arctic outbreaks.

rubric.alert: Deadly cold or winter storms with widespread power or gas outages.
rubric.watch: Top-tier cold or winter-storm warnings across a major region, or a cold wave lifting gas demand sharply.
rubric.normal: No major cold wave or winter storm affecting large populations.
